scenario: `e.msg ~ /^ERROR:/` compiles: after `~` a `/` opens a regex literal, not a division (LREG.6.1), and `~ /` always begins one (LREG.6.3). Read as division, the line would not parse.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /^ERROR:/
->
    log info "ok"
